instruction.name: vaddwev.h.b
instruction.description: Add the even-positioned signed 8-bit elements in `a` and the corresponding signed 8-bit elements in `b`, extending both to 16-bit, and save the 16-bit result in `dst`.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Dependent vector-register chain with small positive integer element values.
